name: Slap Fights 🥊
desc:
🌟 WELCOME To Slap Fights!

❗You may have lost your old slaps, we're working on bringing them back! 

HOW TO PLAY:

🥊 Slap Fight other Players
💵 Win Slap Fights to earn Cash
🏋️‍♂️ Buy better Weights to train faster

⏰ REMEMBER: You Train even while you’re offline! 💪📈
